statement: All implementation files in this distribution were newly written for ResearchOps Toolkit. External projects were decomposed for design patterns; no upstream Skill, prompt, script, template, handbook, or asset is vendored by default.
audit_limitations: Repository provenance declaration, not legal advice.
No claim of forensic similarity proof against every upstream revision.

conceptual_influences: proposal-only safeguard discovery designed for this project
Supervisor-Skills deep-research separation of retrieval evidence from model memory
Supervisor-Skills fatal-flaw, lifecycle/capability fit, and contribution-axis judgment
reproducible run manifests and failure retention
laboratory preflight, calibration, exclusive leases, safe restoration
Ponytail minimum sufficient change and dependency budget
native subagent isolation and bounded handoff
task-conditioned coordination topology instead of fixed occupational personas
compact reusable visual contract abstraction without URL distillation
CCFA-style positive/negative trigger and owner contracts
Anthropic/Google selective loading and evaluation patterns

influences: Existing ResearchOps engineering constraints and the user-specified distinction between research-led and development-led R&D.
software-development.notes: Original implementation; shared assurance concepts are re-expressed through repository-native contracts.

design_decisions.distill_design: URL/brand extraction excluded; static academic visual policy retained
design_decisions.authoritative_state: SQLite under one project-local .researchops/ root; JSONL is import/export only
design_decisions.memory_boundary: Recall memory may suggest context but cannot mutate evaluation, approval, pricing, or routing authority
